name: print-social-infographic-numbered-list-red-gradient
title: Ten-item numbered social media checklist on red gradient
whatItIs: A ten-item two-column list infographic on a dark red-to-purple gradient, each row pairing a large numeral, a simple icon and a short label.
whatItMeans: A strict two-column numbered grid makes a ten-step process feel finite and organized rather than overwhelming, letting a reader mentally 'count down' through it.
techniques: split a long numbered list into two columns to keep the overall shape compact
pair each numeral with a small flat icon for faster visual scanning than text alone
use a dark gradient background so white list cards read with strong contrast

vocabulary.definition: an infographic format organizing content as a sequence of numbered items, often used for steps or tips
